svg.aria-label: Sequence: Strobe A1 sign-in through the auth Lambda and Cognito, an authorised request through the API Gateway JWT authorizer, and an ownership check in the post Lambda
svg.title: Strobe (A1) — where Cognito sits in the photo-sharing app
svg.text: Strobe (A1) — where Cognito sits in the photo-sharing app
Cognito proves who the user is once; API Gateway's JWT authorizer re-checks the token on every protected route; the Lambdas turn the verified sub into ownership rules.
{ email, password } · public route: authorizer skipped
hash keyed by the client secret
profile row keyed by the same sub
only the ID token goes back to the browser
JWT authorizer, before any code runs:
bad or expired token: Lambda never runs
never read from the request body
returns the post, including its owner userId

text.tspan: Why sign-in goes through a Lambda:
the app client is confidential. SECRET_HASH needs the client secret, which a browser can't keep — so the auth Lambda computes it server-side and returns only the ID token.
